stories.title: Ecrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : "On ne va pas se laisser faire", lance Marine Le Pen, qui entend "contre-attaquer" face à Mediapart

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: "We will not let this happen", says Marine Le Pen, who intends to "counter-attack" against Mediapart
en.summary: Mediapart published antisemitic messages from 2013 attributed to the current National Rally president. He announced filing a defamation lawsuit in response.

stories.title: Écrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : «On veut m’assassiner politiquement», déclare le président du RN

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: "They want to assassinate me politically", declares the National Rally president
en.summary: The National Rally president, facing antisemitism accusations, claims they are intended to undermine his political future.

stories.title: Des «propos délirants» : accusé d’écrits antisémites, Jordan Bardella poursuit Mediapart en diffamation

en.title: Described as 'delusional remarks': accused of antisemitic writings, Jordan Bardella sues Mediapart for defamation
en.summary: The National Rally president is pursuing legal action against Mediapart following publication of an article attributing antisemitic and conspiratorial statements to him from 2013. Bardella responded publicly on television, characterizing the allegations as part of a continuing pattern.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella dénonce "les prémices d'une guerre totale" contre le RN après les révélations de Mediapart sur les écrits antisémites qui lui sont attribués

en.title: Jordan Bardella denounces "the beginnings of total war" against the National Rally following Mediapart's revelations about antisemitic writings attributed to him
en.summary: The National Rally stated it would not tolerate the accusations and intended to reveal who was responsible for what it characterized as a coordinated effort against the party.

stories.title: France : grève dans la fonction publique pour protester contre le recul du pouvoir d'achat

en.title: France: public sector strike to protest declining purchasing power
en.summary: Public sector workers demonstrated across France on Tuesday following calls from unified unions protesting the government's 2027 budget proposal and the announced freeze on the civil service salary index.

stories.title: Propos antisémites attribués à Bardella : l'enquête de Mediapart suscite de vives réactions

en.title: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Bardella: Mediapart investigation sparks strong reactions
en.summary: Mediapart published antisemitic messages from 2013 allegedly sent by Jordan Bardella when he was a young National Front activist. Bardella announced a defamation lawsuit and accused the outlet of attempting to destabilize the RN's campaign.

stories.title: Enquête de « Mediapart » sur Jordan Bardella : le RN nie en bloc les propos antisémites, alors que les appels à la démission de son président se multiplient

en.title: Mediapart investigation into Jordan Bardella: RN denies antisemitic remarks as calls for his resignation multiply
en.summary: The RN denies the authenticity of antisemitic messages attributed to Bardella published by Mediapart. An RN deputy blamed former party members purged by Marine Le Pen for leaking the messages to the outlet.

stories.title: "S'il y a des contestations" des écrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella, "nous publierons les documents que nous avons en notre possession", annonce un journaliste de Mediapart

en.title: "If there are disputes" about antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella, "we will publish the documents we have," announces a Mediapart journalist
en.summary: A Mediapart journalist stated the outlet would publish its documents if the RN contests the antisemitic messages attributed to Bardella. The journalist discussed the accusations and the RN's responses to Mediapart's revelations.

stories.title: Accusations d’antisémitisme : dans son match face à «Mediapart», Bardella a les stats contre lui

en.title: Antisemitism accusations: in his match against "Mediapart," Bardella has the statistics against him
en.summary: Bardella announced a defamation lawsuit against Mediapart following accusations of antisemitic remarks. Mediapart cited its strong track record in reporting accuracy regarding such matters.

stories.title: Mélenchon, Bergé, Faure… après les accusations d’antisémitisme de «Mediapart», Jordan Bardella sous le feu des critiques

en.title: Mélenchon, Bergé, Faure… after Mediapart's antisemitism accusations, Jordan Bardella under fire
en.summary: The National Rally president faces criticism from multiple political figures following allegations of antisemitic and conspiracy-related statements made over fifteen years ago, charges he denies while announcing legal action.

stories.title: Révélations de Mediapart : "Jordan Bardella dans l'extrême droite ligne de Jean-Marie Le Pen"

en.title: Mediapart Revelations: "Jordan Bardella in the far-right line of Jean-Marie Le Pen"
en.summary: Mediapart published revelations about antisemitic remarks attributed to RN president Jordan Bardella. The reports prompted reactions across media outlets.

stories.title: "Antisémitisme obsessionnel" ou "barbouzerie" ? Six questions sur les propos attribués à Jordan Bardella par Mediapart

en.title: "Obsessive antisemitism" or "dirty tricks"? Six questions about remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella by Mediapart
en.summary: Mediapart reports that the National Rally leader made antisemitic remarks in conversations between 2013 and 2015. Bardella announced he will pursue legal action against the news outlet.

stories.title: OPINON. « Allocation de rentrée scolaire : derrière le "recentrage", une coupe budgétaire qui punit les familles modestes »

en.title: OPINION. "Back-to-school allowance: behind the 'refocusing', a budget cut punishing modest families"
en.summary: The government announced a possible 600 million euro reduction in back-to-school allowance funding for the 2027 budget, raising concerns about impacts on lower-income families.

stories.title: La France veut sa filière de composites à matrice céramique oxydes

en.title: France wants its oxide ceramic matrix composite sector
en.summary: France is developing oxide ceramic matrix composite technology through the IRT Saint-Exupéry institute's Dioxygen project to produce strategic materials for aerospace engines and nuclear reactors.

stories.title: Confier ses comptes à Meta ? Le pari risqué de l’agent IA Muse

en.title: Entrusting accounts to Meta? The risky bet of AI agent Muse
en.summary: Meta's Muse AI agent, which manages user expenses, gained early enthusiasm in the United States and Canada, though initial flaws and low public trust in Meta raise doubts about its mainstream adoption potential.

stories.title: OPINION. « L'irrésistible ascension du paiement de compte à compte d'ici 2035 »

en.title: OPINION. "The irresistible rise of account-to-account payments by 2035"
en.summary: Bank card networks have dominated global commerce for over fifty years, but technological and regulatory changes are reshaping the payments landscape.

stories.title: OPINION. « Russie : le décret n° 661, ou l’accélération de la mise sous tutelle des actifs étrangers »

en.title: OPINION. "Russia: Decree No. 661, or the acceleration of foreign assets coming under state control"
en.summary: Vladimir Putin signed presidential decree number 661 on September 17, 2026, placing subsidiaries of six foreign groups under provisional state administration.
